evidence_sentence: The function first checks if the provided level is valid.
rationale: The only behavioral delta is handling of a level other than SOL_PPPOL2TP. The vulnerable implementation delegates such requests to udp_prot.getsockopt, whereas the fixed implementation rejects them with -EINVAL. Describing this initial handling as merely validating the level matches the vulnerable implementation's acceptance/delegation behavior and does not accurately describe the fixed implementation's explicit rejection.
rewritten_docstring: The function first handles the provided option level. It retrieves the length of the option and ensures it is non-negative. It then checks if the socket is connected and retrieves the session context. Depending on the session ID, it either retrieves options for the tunnel or the session. Finally, it copies the option value back to user space and updates the length, returning appropriate error codes as needed.
